issue: Python tkinter can truncate NUL/BEL values while transporting list fixtures on some hosts.

fix.randomPool: NUL and BEL removed only from the tkinter-fed random pool
fix.selfCheck: Each Tcl list result is split with tkinter.splitlist and compared with the original values before emission.
fix.directRegression: list_limits_test.mbt checks NUL and BEL at leading, middle and trailing positions without tkinter.

linux.reason: Ubuntu-D WSL has no tkinter; Docker Desktop daemon was unavailable.

scope: This evidence covers generator determinism and the direct list control-character contract; it does not claim full Tcl or cross-platform CI parity.
